title: For each department that both grants degrees (excluding Biology, Course 7,
question: For each department that both grants degrees (excluding Biology, Course 7, and only including those with non-null subject code descriptions) and is named 'Mathematics', list the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students), and calculate the ratio of the subject enrollment variance to the course enrollment variance rounded to two decimal places, ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_depts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'
    AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL
),
subject_stats AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_variance,
         STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_stddev
  FROM eligible_depts d
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
course_stats AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_avg,
         MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_range,
         VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_variance
  FROM eligible_depts d
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
)
SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       ss.subject_variance,
       ss.subject_stddev,
       cs.course_avg,
       cs.course_range,
       cs.course_variance,
       ROUND(ss.subject_variance / NULLIF(cs.course_variance, 0), 2) AS ratio
FROM subject_stats ss
JOIN course_stats cs ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY ratio DESC

SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY comm_intensive_subject_count DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.comm_intensive_subject_count FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = WITH TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(scd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> 'Z' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(scd.COURSE) > 0), DepartmentSubjectInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.total_degree_granting_courses, dsi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsi.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsi.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsi.SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPT_SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column FROM TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS t JOIN DepartmentSubjectInfo AS dsi ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsi.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t.SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column

avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), cte1 AS (SELECT i.LAST_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC), cte2 AS (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.cip_code_variance ORDER BY ic.cip_code_variance DESC) SELECT c1.LAST_NAME, c1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, c1.STUDENT_YEAR, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.window_column, c1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, c2.cip_code_variance FROM cte1 AS c1 JOIN cte2 AS c2 ON c1.SCHOOL_NAME = c2.SCHOOL_NAME AND c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c2.cip_code_variance DESC

  FROM eligible_depts d
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
course_stats AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_avg,
         MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_range,
         VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_variance
  FROM eligible_depts d
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
)

       ss.subject_variance,
       ss.subject_stddev,
       cs.course_avg,
       cs.course_range,
